text_block_list.text:
Red Desire didn't seem to be feeling well, 
so I decided to let her rest in the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern. I shall rest my 
wings for a spell and restore my mana.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, could this be—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The other world!? Did I... did I finally 
make it here!?

text_block_list.name: Noble Daughter A
text_block_list.text:
—Look over there. That's Lady Desire, the 
first prince's fiancée.

text_block_list.name: Noble Daughter B
text_block_list.text:
"My. Buying up jewels and dresses, 
indulging in utter luxury. Notorious for 
doing whatever she pleases behind the 
shield of her family name...?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be... reincarnation, yes, 
but—reincarnating as the villainess!?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, goodness me! Not a saint, but a 
villainess...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If this follows the classic story 
progression, what awaits is condemnation 
and execution...?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —No, calm yourself, Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Being a Saint is not a title, but a way 
of life. Even if I were reincarnated as a 
villainess, that wouldn't change."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With a heart full of justice and 
compassion, reaching out to this world is 
my destiny...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness. I've heard rumors that you 
hold mutual feelings for the woman known 
as this world's Saintess.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I must embark on a journey to bring peace 
to the world. Please, find happiness with 
her."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Wha—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Hear me, O heavens! Hear my prayer from an 
otherworldly realm! Bring forth a rain of 
blessings upon this land...!

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text:
It's a miracle...! Rain is finally falling 
on our drought-stricken village...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"O holy beings, O tainted souls...♪ Bestow 
a crimson blessing equally upon all...♪"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...There. With the sacred song, the 
contaminated well water and crops should 
now be purified."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vile Kraken, despoiler of the seas! I 
shall be your opponent...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaahhh! Holy Magic: Radiant Holy 
Lance!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Long time no see. Somehow, you look even 
more lively than when you were in the 
royal capital."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes! Because... this suits me much better!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it was just a dream. Still, it was 
such a wonderfully fulfilling time.

Red Desire stayed true to her path of the 
saint even in her dream, and seems to be 
feeling much better now.
